messages:
alice.w: Heads up — I noticed ~120 objects in the archival bucket uploaded during yesterday's infra rollback that appear to be stored without SSE-KMS metadata. Can we triage? :eyes:
encops-bot: Alert: archive-upload-unencrypted detected (rule: s3-sse-required). First hit: s3://redwood-archive/2026-03-20/archive-20260320T03Z.tar.gz
brian_sre: ugh. can you paste head-object output for one of the objects?
alice.w: sure — pasted below (redacted):
```
$ aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-archive --key 2026-03-20/archive-20260320T03Z.tar.gz
{
  "ContentLength": 324234234,
  "ContentType": "application/x-tar",
  "ETag": "\"abc123\"",
  "Metadata": {},
  "ServerSideEncryption": null
}
```
carol-sec: if ServerSideEncryption is null that's a compliance issue. freeze deletions on that prefix, and do not notify the customer yet. we need chain-of-custody and who had write perms during the 02:45-03:30 window.
dan-platform: rolling back the infra deploy touched the uploader service account mapping — there's a migration hook that flips the role binding. suspect script removed the kms:Encrypt permission temporarily. i'll grep deploy logs. :mag:
alice.w: cloudtrail shows PutObject by principal arn:aws:sts::111111111111:assumed-role/uploader-deploy-role-session at 2026-03-20T03:05:12Z
carol-sec: good. gather these artifacts: CloudTrail event, S3 object head, deploy logs, and IAM change diff. put them in the incident doc. this is a P2 until we know exposure.
brian_sre: quick checks i run (for whoever picks this up):
```
# list grants for the CMK used by archival
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111111111:key/abcd-ef01

# find objects without SSE-KMS
aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-archive --prefix 2026-03-20/ | jq -r '.Contents[].Key' | while read k; do aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-archive --key "$k" | jq -r '(.Key // "") + " " + (.ServerSideEncryption // "NONE")'; done
```
dan-platform: deploy logs show migration script v2.4.1 ran with args `--bind-uploader-role -rollback` at 2026-03-20T02:58:07Z. the script has a path where it unsets an inline policy before reattaching with new perms. looks like it failed to reattach kms:Encrypt for the uploader role for ~40m. adding log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T02:58:07Z INFO starting role migration
2026-03-20T02:58:09Z WARN removing inline-policy uploader-write-temporary
2026-03-20T02:58:10Z INFO attach-policy uploader-write-v2
2026-03-20T02:58:10Z ERROR attach-policy failed (timeout) -> retry suppressed
2026-03-20T03:40:15Z INFO attach-policy succeeded
```
carol-sec: that's the window. next: scope the objects uploaded during that gap. tag them as evidence and set retention-lock for 90 days. open ticket for legal if any tenant data present.
alice.w: i've already added an S3 object tag `inc:archive-unencrypted=true` for the 120 objects and set a deny-delete object lock (retention mode GOVERNANCE 90d) where allowed. left a comment in the incident doc with the S3 keys.
brian_sre: remediation options: (1) re-upload encrypted copy using server-side encryption with CMK (recommended), (2) apply client-side encryption if available, (3) if re-upload impossible, rotate the CMK and flag as potential exposure for customers. need owner to action.
carol-sec: do not rotate customer-visible CMKs without exec OK. start with re-ingest: @dan-platform take lead on re-upload plan and schedule. set target T+24h for bulk re-encrypt and T+72h for full verification.
dan-platform: ack. i'll run a non-destructive script to copy objects with SSE-KMS to a temp prefix, verify checksums, then swap manifests. will coordinate downtime window if needed. posting pseudo commands:
```
# non-destructive copy with SSE-KMS
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-archive/2026-03-20/archive-20260320T03Z.tar.gz s3://redwood-archive-encrypted/2026-03-20/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111111111:key/abcd-ef01
```
encops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03-20-007 — archival unencrypted uploads during migration window. Severity: P2. Assigned: dan-platform.
carol-sec: add follow-ups: (a) fix migration script to do attach-policy with backoff + alert on failures, (b) add pre-commit check to CI that ensures uploader role retains kms:Encrypt, (c) add CloudTrail alarm on PutObject without SSE-KMS to detect earlier.
brian_sre: i'll open a PR for the migration script fix and include unit tests. wil l add CloudWatch alarm for missing SSE header pattern.
alice.w: thanks all. i'll continue mapping objects -> tenants and update the incident doc with evidence. :white_check_mark:
